content: The neon() HTTP-mode client from @neondatabase/serverless does not use or need a pooled TCP connection at all -- each query is a stateless HTTPS fetch, so there is no connection pool to exhaust and no cold-start connection penalty. This is the correct default for one-shot queries per serverless invocation (exactly this project's pattern). Pool/Client over WebSockets is only needed for multi-statement interactive transactions; for atomic multi-statement writes without switching drivers, the HTTP client exposes sql.transaction() for batched non-interactive transactions.
